NY Academy of Art needs name of scholarship by tomorrow, May 4th. Please advise.


On Apr 26, 2012, at 3:52 PM, Elizabeth Hobson wrote:


            Dear


            I am writing to confirm how Jeffrey would prefer the scholarship to be
            named that was created through his contribution to Tribeca Ball 2012.
             This scholarship will be given to a continuing Academy student at this
            spring's commencement ceremony on Friday, May 18, 2012.


            In order for us to finalize our award process, please confirm before
            Friday, May 4.


            Thank you for helping coordinate all these details.


            Best,

            Liz
